summary: My Library writes, two follow-up commits to the sign-in and system-surfaces review. A queued write is sent after a profile switch to its own profile (a local check had dropped an Undo the server accepts); in-flight marks are kept per profile and title (a title both profiles had saved could leave the second profile's list after a switch); a queued write is not sent after a sign-out. Two passes by the independent reviewer: lows-only, held because a sentence in CLAUDE.md was false until the marks were per profile; then lows-only on this commit: the owner ref one effect phase behind the other two (a suspicion from reading), the end-of-queue read's half of the owner check unpinned, and no test for the reverse case. All three are with the builder as a last small commit.
